item.description:
XHelpers Pro 1.0.12 (30)
- AI Usage keeps reading Codex usage after the Codex CLI is upgraded, and finds a correctly signed Codex or Claude Code however it was installed, so automatic sign-in renewal keeps working. - Help in the AI Usage card now appears only over its own control and disappears as soon as the pointer moves away. - Install Apps & Dev Tools now installs Claude Code and Codex CLI with their vendors' own installers, which keep them up to date. - Manage Fonts adds Hack, DejaVu Sans Mono, Hack Nerd Font and JetBrains Mono Nerd Font. - The detached video window's menus now offer audio effects, playback details, opening files, settings and queue actions. - Player messages count a single item correctly and read more clearly. - The app is about 60 MB smaller: the Finder and Quick Look extensions now carry only their own text. - Completed translations in 25 languages.
